question: I would like to know the given names of baseball players who have achieved the highest value of games played, runs, hits, and home runs, with their corresponding score values.
sql:
WITH career_stats AS (
    SELECT player_id, 
           TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(g AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT) as career_g, 
           TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(r AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT) as career_r, 
           TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(h AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT) as career_h, 
           TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(hr AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT) as career_hr
    FROM batting 
    WHERE TRY_CAST(g AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_id
),
max_vals AS (
    SELECT MAX(career_g) as max_g, MAX(career_r) as max_r, MAX(career_h) as max_h, MAX(career_hr) as max_hr
    FROM career_stats
),
leaders AS (
    SELECT p.name_given, p.name_first, p.name_last,
           cs.career_g as games_played,
           cs.career_r as runs,
           cs.career_h as hits,
           cs.career_hr as home_runs,
           CASE WHEN cs.career_g = mv.max_g THEN 'Games Played' END as category,
           CASE WHEN cs.career_g = mv.max_g THEN cs.career_g END as value
    FROM career_stats cs
    JOIN player p ON cs.player_id = p.player_id
    CROSS JOIN max_vals mv
    WHERE cs.career_g = mv.max_g 
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.name_given, p.name_first, p.name_last,
           cs.career_g, cs.career_r, cs.career_h, cs.career_hr,
           'Runs', cs.career_r
    FROM career_stats cs
    JOIN player p ON cs.player_id = p.player_id
    CROSS JOIN max_vals mv
    WHERE cs.career_r = mv.max_r
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.name_given, p.name_first, p.name_last,
           cs.career_g, cs.career_r, cs.career_h, cs.career_hr,
           'Hits', cs.career_h
    FROM career_stats cs
    JOIN player p ON cs.player_id = p.player_id
    CROSS JOIN max_vals mv
    WHERE cs.career_h = mv.max_h
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.name_given, p.name_first, p.name_last,
           cs.career_g, cs.career_r, cs.career_h, cs.career_hr,
           'Home Runs', cs.career_hr
    FROM career_stats cs
    JOIN player p ON cs.player_id = p.player_id
    CROSS JOIN max_vals mv
    WHERE cs.career_hr = mv.max_hr
)
SELECT name_given, name_first, name_last, category, value
FROM leaders
ORDER BY name_given, category
